result_summary.title: Refunds not processed and subscriptions failing to renew in Development
result_summary.description: We are seeing two major issues in our Development environment on Payment Gateway v2 (ANZ region). First, refund transactions initiated via the API are not reflecting as completed in the dashboard; they remain stuck in 'processing'. Second, approximately 1,200 test accounts with active subscriptions failed to renew this cycle despite valid cards on file. This is blocking our release pipeline. Please investigate ASAP.
